note: Black Hawk County Conservation park (in Tama County) near La Porte City, 723 acres around 39-acre Casey Lake and Casey's Paha State Preserve. The campground is a big loop on open, tree-dotted ground NE of the lake; its west and south rows sit ~70-90 m from the shore behind the park road, parking lots and a tree belt. Rustic and modern cabins, disc golf, trails, boat ramp. Casey Lake drawdown/excavation work has caused periodic disruptions. --Claude
summary: Fees changed 30-35 -> 25-35 (2024 sheet: walk-in electric $25 is the cheapest RV site). Sites changed 69 -> 78 (campsite map). Added 50-amp, potable water, booking detail (15 reservable sites, 2-night min, 4 on holidays). Confirmed water/sewer, showers, flush toilets, dump, closes Nov 1. Not waterfront stands: no loop is on Casey Lake.
flags: WATERFRONT not waterfront stands; no lakeview lead. No campground loop touches Casey Lake. The west row (sites 2-22) is ~70-90 m from the lake's east arm, across the park entry road, the boat-ramp parking loop and lot, and a belt of trees. The south end (sites 22-30) is ~60-80 m from the north shore behind the road, the big parking lot and a wooded strip. Imagery shows clumped canopy between rows and shore, and none of the county's campground photos shows the lake. The NW corner by the parking loop is the most open; at best a glimpse there, not a view a camper can count on.

FEES: the stored $30-35 were the reservation prices only. The county's rate sheet (created 2024-11-22, linked as 'Rates' on the park page) gives walk-in electric $25 and full hookup $30, so the low is $25. Non-electric $18 applies to the primitive area, which is not a pad a motorhome is shown to fit.
SITES: the map (updated 2022-03-16) numbers 78 sites, all 50/30/20-amp electric or full hookup; the old note's '~69 units, 47 electric' is superseded.
PIN ~305 m off: stored 42.27050,-92.30950 is at the park office/entrance north of the campground. The campground loop centre is ~42.2678,-92.3094 (Esri), ~305 m south. Suggest 42.2678,-92.3094.
SEASON: closes 11-01 per the park page; the spring opening is 'when weather permits' (no date). 'Open year round 6am-10:30pm' is park hours.
FIT: no rig length posted; the map's back-in and pull-off pads are drawn long and RVs of all sizes appear in imagery.
